a Al8Nb27Ti29V28Zr8 alloy was produced by arc melting in a water-cooled copper crucible using high purity metals (min. 99.7%) in high purity argon atmosphere (min. 99.995%), with titanium as a getter. Multiple ingots were produced, and to ensure chemical homogeneity, each was inverted and remelted at least five times.

Al8Nb27Ti29V28Zr8 multi-principal element alloy (MPEA) was prepared via arc melting.

a Al8Nb27Ti29V28Zr8 alloy was produced by arc melting in a water-cooled copper crucible using high purity metals (min. 99.7%) in high purity argon atmosphere (min. 99.995%), with titanium as a getter.
Homogenization heat treatment was carried out at 1200 ◦C/24 h aiming to eliminate segregation from the as-solidified microstructure as well as to obtain a BCC single phase microstructure.
After homogenization a subsequent heat treatment was carried out at 700 ◦C/168 h to evaluate phase stability.
